breakpoints.note: First project statement that materializes attacker-controlled included text as the xmlNode object later cached in ctxt->txtTab and eventually reused after reader cleanup.

The XInclude cache stores the reader-owned xmlNodePtr itself instead of duplicating stable text content or transferring ownership, so ctxt->txtTab retains a pointer that can become dangling after xmlreader cleanup frees the node.
